india.one_line: OpenAI expands Indian infrastructure as India becomes ChatGPT's largest market, alongside major funding and local model launches.

themes.title: India becomes ChatGPT's largest market
themes.text: India has become ChatGPT's largest global market by weekly active users, prompting OpenAI to launch local API inference residency for regulated sectors.

stories.headline: OpenAI adds API inference residency for GPT-6 Luna in India
India is now ChatGPT's largest market globally by weekly active users

themes.title: Chariot launches multilingual Indian TTS model
themes.text: Research lab Chariot released a new text-to-speech model supporting 11 Indian languages with contextual reasoning and voice cloning.

stories.headline: Chariot launches multilingual TTS model with support for 11 Indian languages

themes.title: Norwest closes $4 billion AI fund
themes.text: Norwest closed a $4 billion fund to invest in early and growth-stage AI startups in India, the US, and Israel.

stories.headline: Norwest closes $4 billion fund to back AI startups in US, India and Israel
